ja80:1.1: yaṁ te → yante (bj, sya-all) | pavikatthitaṁ → cikkatthitaṁ (bj: machasaṁ)
ja80:2.1: bhīmasenajātakaṁ → bhimmasenajātakaṁ (bj: machasaṁ) | varaṇavaggo → varuṇa (bj: machasaṁ, syā)
ja80:4.1: varuṇā akataññūvare tu saccavaraṁ → varaṇā akataññūvaresusaccavaraṁ (bj)
ja80:4.3: karuṇāya silāplava illisato → karuṇāyasilāplavaitthisato (bj) | silāplava → silāpalva (sya-all)
ja80:4.4: ḍiṇḍimapūtisarena dasāti → deṇḍimapūtisarena dasa (bj); dindima pūtisarena dasa (sya-all)
